选择和竞争28 商业街的形成
如果把经营范围差不多的商店聚集到一起的话，来买东西的客人的数量也会多起来。这是因为客人可以货比三家，而且，各个商家为了卖出更多的东西，往往会降低一些价格。另外，由于商家比较集中，这样更容易被更多的人熟知，从而吸引更多的客人前来。
这里是电子街。在这里可以买到电视、照相机、电脑等各种各样的电子产品。
跟着妈妈去买衣服，还能吃米糕哦。
你去过电子街吗？那里的每家商店都有电冰箱、电话、电熨斗等各种各样的电子产品。
这里是服装城。在这里可以买到衣服、鞋子、各种装饰品。
在服装城里可以买到小朋友的衣服以及爸爸妈妈的衣服。
这里是米糕街。
这里是可以吃到米糕、冰淇淋的米糕街。
要是有一家米糕店生意好的话，其他人也会开米糕店。渐渐地，就形成了一条米糕街。
page_text_en:
Remember these!
Choice and Competition 28 Formation of Commercial Streets
If stores with similar business scopes gather together, the number of customers buying things will increase. This is because customers can compare prices among three or more stores, and also, each store will often lower its prices to sell more goods. Additionally, since stores are concentrated, they are more easily recognized by more people, thus attracting more customers.
This is Electronics Street. Here you can buy televisions, cameras, computers, and various electronic products.
Following Mom to buy clothes, you can also eat rice cakes.
Have you been to Electronics Street? Each store there has refrigerators, telephones, irons, and various electronic products.
This is Fashion City. Here you can buy clothes, shoes, and various accessories.
In Fashion City, you can buy clothes for children and for Mom and Dad.
This is Rice Cake Street.
This is Rice Cake Street, where you can eat rice cakes and ice cream.
If one rice cake shop does well, others will also open rice cake shops. Gradually, a rice cake street is formed.
summary_zh: 本页通过电子街、服装城和米糕街的例子，解释了商业街形成的原理：同类店铺聚集能吸引更多顾客，形成竞争，从而促进商业发展。
